import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# Scatter plot: Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
scatter1 = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['sepal_length'], df['sepal_width'], 
                              c=df['species'].map({'setosa': 0, 'versicolor': 1, 'virginica': 2}), 
                              cmap='viridis', alpha=0.8, s=60)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sepal Length vs Sepal Width by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Scatter plot: Petal Length vs Petal Width
scatter2 = axes[0, 1].scatter(df['petal_length'], df['petal_width'], 
                              c=df['species'].map({'setosa': 0, 'versicolor': 1, 'virginica': 2}), 
                              cmap='plasma', alpha=0.8, s=60)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Petal Length vs Petal Width by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Box plot: Sepal Length by Species
sns.boxplot(ax=axes[1, 0], x='species', y='sepal_length', data=df, palette='Set2')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Sepal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Box plot: Petal Length by Species
sns.boxplot(ax=axes[1, 1], x='species', y='petal_length', data=df, palette='Set3')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Create custom legend for scatter plots
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
legend_elements = [Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#440154', 
                          markersize=10, label='Setosa'),
                   Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#21918c', 
                          markersize=10, label='Versicolor'),
                   Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#fde725', 
                          markersize=10, label='Virginica')]

axes[0, 0].legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right')
axes[0, 1].legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.suptitle('Iris Dataset Analysis: Feature Distributions and Relationships', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
